answer.says: Masterji, the distinction is noted. The paper is the measure, not the hand. I will take it to the bench and finish it in peace.
answer.thought: A small act of hygiene in a chaotic market; the separation of the object from the common touch preserves its integrity. I have had enough oil and salt to sustain me until I return to the bungalow. The air is cooling, and the market is thinning out, which is the correct time to depart before the dark settles in.
